title: Private deployment requests routed to GPU-incompatible quantized variant during capacity spike
creator: Priya Patel
description: Summary: Production customer (enterprise private deployment) observed a sudden increase in inference errors and model failures during a regional capacity spike. Traffic that should have been routed to a CPU-backed compatibility variant was instead sent to a quantized INT4 variant that requires GPU execution paths, causing OOMs / failed executions and elevated error rates. Impact: multiple customers in the EU private cluster experienced degraded availability for 10-25 minutes; two customers filed urgent support escalations; SLA latency SLOs violated for affected tenants. Root cause hypothesis: a refactor in the fallback policy evaluator (change set runtime-routing v2) removed the execution_target compatibility predicate from the candidate comparator for private-targeted routes. The comparator still applied hardware-capacity tags (gpu/dedicated/hosted) but did not filter incompatible quantization-execution combinations when deriving a fallback. During high load the smart-router selected the highest-priority capacity bucket that matched capacity tags but didn't validate execution_target -> quantized variant mismatch, causing misroute to a variant compiled for GPU-only execution on nodes that lacked the correct runtime, leading to crashes. Repro steps: 1) Simulate private cluster capacity saturation by reducing available dedicated GPUs (test rig: eu-west-priv-01). 2) Trigger model route evaluation for tenant T-3319 with request flags: prefer_low_cost=true, allow_quantized=true. 3) Observe selected variant id qv-int4-v2 on instances without GPU runtime; Grafana shows crash loop and elevated 5xx for the tenant. Short-term mitigation applied: added an emergency routing policy to tenant T-3319 to pin to cpu-compatible variants and temporarily blacklisted qv-int4-v2 at the private-cluster routing layer. Mitigation link: internal routing override applied: https://grafana.internal/redwood/routing-overrides/ENG-127890. Permanent fix: restore execution_target compatibility check in fallback comparator, add unit+integration tests that include (execution_target x quantization_profile) matrix, add end-to-end canary rollout for private clusters, and backport the patch to runtime-1.20 as an urgent hotfix. Rollout plan: patch -> canary on 2 non-critical private tenants -> monitor for 48h -> full rollout. Postmortem & action items documented below.
